title: Japanese Pan-Seared Salmon
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-inspired dish featuring pan-seared salmon with a crispy exterior and tender interior.
instructions: 1. Season the salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
2. Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add the salmon fillets to the skillet, skin side up (if they have skin).
4. Cook for 3-4 minutes, until the skin is crispy.
5. Flip the salmon over and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes, until cooked through.
6. In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar, and grated ginger.
7. Pour the sauce over the salmon and cook for an additional minute.
8. Garnish with chopped chill and serve immediately.
